1) Kerala Lottery – History & Purpose

Kerala’s state-run lottery was launched to create a transparent, regulated alternative to informal gambling and to raise funds for public welfare. Over the years, named draws and seasonal bumper lotteries helped standardize prize structures and weekly schedules. Today the program is widely followed across India, with draws published on the official gazette and summarized here for faster access.

For older draws, browse the Kerala lottery results list and the monthly chart. For a quick check of the latest draw, use Kerala Lottery Result Today.

2) Legality & Safety

Kerala Lottery is government-run and published officially. Always verify winning numbers against the State Lottery Department’s gazette before claiming. Avoid unverified intermediaries or “online sellers”. Buy only from authorized agents and keep your physical ticket safe until the claim process is complete.

We list results and charts for convenience, but the gazette is the final authority. See our full archive and charts below for cross-checks.

3) Kerala Lottery Names & Weekly Schedule

Popular draws include Bhagyathara, Sthree Sakthi, Dhanalekshmi, Karunya Plus, Suvarna Keralam, Karunya, Samrudhi, Win-Win and Akshaya. Each has a fixed weekday slot and distinct prize structure. Jump directly to their result hubs:

  • Bhagyathara Lottery Result
  • Sthree Sakthi Lottery Result
  • Dhanalekshmi Lottery Result
  • Karunya Plus Lottery Result
  • Suvarna Keralam Lottery
  • Karunya Lottery Result
  • Samrudhi Lottery Result

  • Akshaya Lottery Result
  • Dear Lottery Result

For a one-glance weekly overview, see the Kerala Lottery Weekly Chart.

4) How to Use Kerala Lottery Charts (Daily / Weekly / Monthly / Yearly)

Charts help you browse past winning numbers by date or by draw name. Use the daily & weekly chart for recent checks and the monthly/yearly charts for deeper lookup. Machine numbers can help you cross-reference draw codes.

  • Kerala Lottery Chart Daily & Weekly
  • Kerala Lottery Monthly Chart
  • Yearly Charts (2024/2025)
  • Machine Numbers
  • Kerala Lottery Results List

Tip: when verifying results, always cross-reference the chart entry with the official gazette number for that date.

5) How to Claim Prize (Overview)

Keep the original ticket intact and sign the back. Verify the number on the official gazette, then prepare ID proof, bank details, and photographs as required. Submit the claim with the correct form via the appropriate office or bank, depending on prize amount and rules in force.

Rules and thresholds can change. Use our archive for quick checks, but follow the latest instructions from the State Lottery Department. When in doubt, consult the official channel linked on this page.

6) Where to Buy Kerala Lottery Tickets

Buy only from authorized retail agents/outlets in Kerala. Keep purchase receipts. Be wary of any website or social account claiming to sell official Kerala tickets online — verify legitimacy and avoid sharing sensitive information.

We do not sell tickets. This site aggregates official results, charts and archives to help you verify numbers quickly and safely.

7) Weekly Draw Timetable

Here is the typical weekly rotation for named draws. Use the links to jump to each draw’s hub and historical results.

For a one-glance weekly overview, also see the Kerala Lottery Weekly Chart.

8) How to Verify Results (Step-by-Step)

  1. Find your draw date and ticket series. Use Kerala Lottery Results List or the Monthly Chart to locate the date.
  2. Cross-check winning numbers with the official publication (gazette). Treat charts on this site as a quick index; the official source is the final authority.
  3. Match the series/code carefully (don’t rely on partial matches). Where available, use Machine Numbers for additional cross-reference.
  4. Keep the physical ticket intact (no damage, staples or heavy folds). Sign the back and secure the ticket until you file the claim.

Verify the draw against the official publication, then double-check via our Kerala Lottery Result Today and the weekly chart.

If any discrepancy exists between a chart and the official gazette, use the gazette number as final. We update our pages to reflect corrections promptly.

9) Prize Claim — Documents & Flow

Prepare original ticket (signed), valid ID, bank details, and photographs as required. Follow the latest instructions from the State Lottery Department. For high-value prizes you may need to visit a designated office/bank branch with the prescribed forms.

Always verify the result first (see above) and keep copies of everything you submit. Rules and thresholds can change—use the official guidance linked on this page when you proceed.

10) Responsible Play & Eligibility

Participate responsibly and only if you meet the legal eligibility requirements in your jurisdiction. Never share sensitive information with unverified sources, and avoid unlicensed sellers or “online agents”.

This website does not sell tickets. We aggregate results, charts and archives to help you verify numbers quickly and safely.

11) Ticket Security & Common Scams

  • Genuine ticket checks: look for printed security elements (seal/hologram/barcode). Keep your ticket dry and legible.
  • Beware of impersonation: officials do not request fees via messaging apps. Verify any outreach via official channels.
  • No remote “claims”: filing usually requires your presence or verified submission—avoid sending originals by post without guidance.

12) Glossary: Common Terms

Draw / Result Time
Scheduled time when winning numbers are published (often 3:00 PM IST for the main draw).
Gazette
The official publication that confirms winning numbers; the final reference for prize claims.
Machine Number
An auxiliary code used for cross-reference; see Machine Numbers.
Archive / Chart
Historical listings by date/draw; see Results List and Monthly Chart.
